reader_summary.headline: My guest in this episode is Sandrine Ungari, head of cross-asset quantitative research at Socham.
reader_summary.overview: My guest in this episode is Sandrine Ungari, head of cross-asset quantitative research at Socham. Sandrine cut her teeth in the industry as a fixed-income pricing quant, but made her way over to sell-side investment quant research in 2006. Her early research focused on credit and macro, but since 2012 has been heavily focused on equity and alternative risk premium.

key_points.text: Our conversation begins with equity factors, and Sandrine provides insight both into how factor construction has evolved over the last decade.
key_points.evidence_quote: Our conversation begins with equity factors, and Sandrine provides insight both into how factor construction has evolved over the last decade, as well as her thoughts into where the field is headed.

key_points.text: We broaden our discussion to include alternative risk premium and sandrine provides a useful mental map map for categorizing this broad range of strategies.
key_points.evidence_quote: We broaden our discussion to include alternative risk premium and sandrine provides a useful mental map map for categorizing this broad range of strategies.

key_points.text: We discuss the risks of crowding, latent beta risk and levered factors, and the influence of macroeconomics.
key_points.evidence_quote: We discuss the risks of crowding, latent beta risk and levered factors, and the influence of macroeconomics.

key_points.text: More recently, Sandrine has focused her research in the application of machine learning and strategy construction.
